text:
**用户：**
能不能把约束高度变小？这样是不是能更好解决问题？

**AI：**
<think>用户想把约束高度变小。约束高度越小，光标越早离开约束区，越早触发步进。这样在慢速滚动时光标移动更频繁（每项都移），感觉更跟手。

但太小的话，快速滚动时会一直在追步，体验也不好。

让我先看看当前值，然后改小试试。</think>对，约束区域越小，光标越早离开触发步进，慢速滚动时就能逐项响应。改成 32px（刚好一项高度）：
<tool_Yzj1 name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "sed -i 's/const CONSTRAINT_HEIGHT = 96/const CONSTRAINT_HEIGHT = 32/' /root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/ui.ts && cd /root/kfmv4 && node build.mjs 2>&1 && pkill -f 'node dist/server' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; nohup node dist/server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 0.5 && git add -A && git commit -m 'fix: constraint height 96px -> 32px for tighter cursor follow'"}</param>
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
</tool_Yzj1><tool_result_Kh4G name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"Build OK\n[detached HEAD 2ad8201] fix: constraint height 96px -> 32px for tighter cursor follow\n 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_Kh4G>
commit: `2ad8201`

96px → 32px。光标只要偏离中心超过半个项高就触发步进，慢速滚动也能逐项响应了。

洛，刷新验证。
